facts.text: Živí se hmyzem, například kobylkami, saranči a mouchami.
facts.quote: a diet consisting of insects like grasshoppers, locust, and flies

facts.text: Při hledání potravy dupe, aby z půdy vypudil bezobratlé.
facts.quote: they might stomp their feet to disturb and reveal invertebrates in the soil
It is also known to roost in trees.

facts.text: Mláďata se pasou s rodiči na loukách už den po vylíhnutí.
facts.quote: Chicks will forage with their parents in grassland areas the day after hatching.

facts.text: Vejce zahřívají samec i samice 28 až 31 dní.
facts.quote: Incubation of eggs will be performed by both males and females and will last 28–31 days.

facts.text: Samci hlídají hnízdo na blízkých stromech, zatímco samice hledají potravu.
facts.quote: Males are known to stand guard by the nest in nearby trees, prepared to signal a threat, as females forage.
